note: From the Louisiana Secretary of State's candidate list and sample ballots for all 85 Ouachita Parish precincts; the District Attorney race is the only local item on every precinct ballot. Unopposed candidates were declared elected and do not appear on the ballot: Associate Justice of the Supreme Court 4th District, 4th Judicial District Court Election Section 1 Divisions G and J and Election Section 2 Divisions A, C, D, E, F and K, Monroe City Court Divisions A, B and C, Ouachita Parish School Board Districts B, C, E and G, Monroe City School Board Districts 2 and 3, Sterlington mayor and police chief, and most Justices of the Peace and Constables. Ouachita Parish Police Jury seats are not on this ballot. PSC District 5 is a state district office. Not shown because they depend on where you live: 4th Judicial District Court Election Section 1 Divisions H and I and Election Section 2 Division B; Monroe City Court marshal and West Monroe City Court judge and marshal (on the ballot within each court's jurisdiction, which does not match city limits); Ouachita Parish School Board Districts A, D and F; Monroe City School Board Districts 1, 4, 5, 6 and 7; Justices of the Peace and Constables; and Sterlington aldermen. The City of Monroe has no city-only item on this ballot. 'No Party' candidates are shown as Independent. Incumbency is not marked because the official list does not indicate it. Check your official sample ballot.
